cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(btcmake C)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
option(BT_FOO "foo" OFF)
add_executable(btcmake main.c)
if(BT_FOO)
	target_compile_definitions(btcmake PRIVATE BT_FOO=1)
endif()
target_compile_definitions(btcmake PRIVATE "BT_BAR=\"${BT_BAR}\"")
install(TARGETS btcmake)
install(FILES btcmake.conf DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_SYSCONFDIR})
